# Restore pre-split public learn guides across public spokes

Terminal predicate: every public product guide listed in the default-deny `docs/public-manifest.json` of `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` (`62`), `neomjs/devindex` (`26`), and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` (`7`) renders at its canonical `neomjs.com/learn/*` URL inside the single `229`-leaf Portal Learn tree and Googlebot SSR with spoke-commit `<lastmod>` in `sitemap-core.xml` and `llms*.txt`, all `33` renamed/moved/retired pre-split nav routes return HTTP `301` (`-> 200`, gated on generated SSR route presence) or `410` at `middleware-v2`, spoke CI blocks host paths, private-repo identifiers, and client names, and all `14` pre-split ranking `/learn/*` URLs in `sc-domain:neomjs.com` record zero HTTP `404` responses.

## Problem Scope

Splitting the organization's repositories by domain (`#17786` / `#17791` / `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#10`, ADR 0040) removed `148` Markdown files and `121` historical `learn/tree.json` navigation leaves (`2026-06-01` onward) from `neomjs/neo/learn/` while leaving `neomjs.com`'s site build (`neomjs/pages` + `neomjs/middleware-v2`) coupled exclusively to `neomjs/neo/learn/`.

Live `sc-domain:neomjs.com` 3-month Search Console + Googlebot HTTP probes (`2026-11-21` / `2026-11-22`, `neomjs/neo` Discussion #20920) proved this created an active search regression:
- Across all `21` `/learn/*` URLs that earned Google Search impressions (`121` impressions), **`14` URLs (`66.7%`) accounting for `73` impressions (`60.3%`) now return `HTTP 404`**, including `10` Page-1 rankings (`pos 3.0–10.0`).
- Across all `69` `neomjs/neo` `learn/tree.json` revisions since `2026-06-01`, **`121` removed navigation leaf IDs** partition with zero gap into **`62`** `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` product guides, **`26`** `neomjs/devindex` guides, and **`33`** renamed/moved/retired routes (`24` `301`s + `9` `410`s), plus **`7`** `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` product guides (`134` Engine leaves + `95` spoke leaves = **`229` Learn leaves**).
- Because restoring these guides spans three independent public spoke repositories (`neo-agent-brain`, `devindex`, `neo-agent-institution`), the `neomjs/pages` build-time materializer, `neomjs/middleware-v2` routing/SSR, and `neomjs/neo` Portal/SEO composition — each with distinct CI gates and release-line cadences — an Epic is required to coordinate the multi-repo leaves toward one shared user/search outcome.

## Intended Solution Shape

Graduated from `neomjs/neo` Discussion #20920 (**Option `A0 + A1` Restore Slice**, `[DIVERGENCE_FOLDED @ DC_kwDODSospM4BLh9b]`):

1. **File-Level Default-Deny `docs/public-manifest.json` + Spoke CI Publish Lint (`A1`):**
   - Each public spoke repository owns `docs/public-manifest.json` (`schema: "public-manifest.v1"`) explicitly mapping curated product Markdown files (`file` -> canonical `/learn/...` `route`) plus `learn/tree.json` navigation nodes.
   - Per-file route baseline (`OQ-2`, [#discussioncomment-19803727](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19803727), [#discussioncomment-19804237](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19804237)): `62` Brain product nav leaves (`23` Agent OS + `18` Tooling & Configuration + `15` Deploying the Agent OS + `6` `benefits/brain/*`) and `26` DevIndex nav leaves (`715d48d101^`) return at their exact pre-split `/learn/...` URLs (`88` exact restores); `7` `neo-agent-institution` product guides mount at `/learn/institution/*`.
   - Brain's `50` files in `decisions/`, `measurements/`, and `incidents/` (`5` of which held former nav entries and receive `410` rows in `a0-a1-redirects`), Brain's `13` net-new files without pre-split nav entries (Stage-2 expansion), Institution's `5` `learn/agentos/decisions/*.md` ADRs, and private `neomjs/neo-stage` (`48` files) stay unlisted.
   - Each spoke's CI runs a publish lint failing closed on real host paths (`/Users/<user>`, `/home/<user>`), private-repo identifiers (`business`, `neo-stage`, `neo-pro`), broken relative links, and client names while permitting public `@neo-*` roster handles.

2. **Single Pinned Build-Time Materialization & `#20498` Hub Tree Composition (`neomjs/pages` -> `neomjs/middleware-v2`):**
   - `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/contentPins.json` pins each public spoke at an explicit 40-hex commit SHA, and Step 4.1 of `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs` materializes admitted `.md` files into `node_modules/neo.mjs/learn/...` with spoke commit timestamps (`<lastmod>`) and composes the `95` spoke leaves into `node_modules/neo.mjs/learn/tree.json` (`134 -> 229` leaves: Brain `benefits/brain/*` `6` under `Benefits` as `"The Brain - Agent OS"` before Body; Brain `agentos/*` `56` as `3` groups + Institution `7` as `"Agent Institution"` per ADR 0018 OD-4 under `AgentInterfaces`; DevIndex `26` under `Guides` > `"DevIndex App"`), failing closed on any hub/spoke route collision before Step 7 runs `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`.

3. **Deterministic `33`-Row `301` / `410` Route Table at `neomjs/middleware-v2` (`a0-a1-redirects`):**
   - `neomjs/middleware-v2/src/server.mjs` serves all `9` `410` rows immediately and gates each of the `24` `301` rows on **generated SSR route presence** (`dist/seo/learn/<target>/index.html`, per [#discussioncomment-19804237](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19804237)) so unlisted orphan `.md` files never trigger `301 -> 404` chains; the `17` Wave-A `301`s (`200 OK` live today) + `9` `410`s (`26` routes) ship immediately without waiting for `neomjs/pages#158`, while the `6` `benefits/brain/*` `301`s and `NeuralSwarm -> RoundTable` `301` activate automatically once their generated routes build:

## Avoided Traps

- **Moving spoke guides back into `neomjs/neo/learn/` or committing mirrored copies:** violates ADR 0040, #17791, and `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#10` by recreating dual-repo drift.
- **Directory-level `learn/**` allowlists:** publishes operational session/measurement records and local host paths from multi-tenant repos.
- **Deriving redirect coverage from `git log --diff-filter=D` alone:** misses `22` pages renamed/moved inside `neo`; walking every `learn/tree.json` version since `2026-06-01` accounts for all `121` removed leaves ([#discussioncomment-19803727](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19803727)).
- **Gating `301`s on raw `dist/raw/learn/*.md` instead of generated SSR routes (`dist/seo/learn/<target>/index.html`):** `fetchContent.mjs` copies unlisted orphan `.md` files too, while bots receive `404` for ungenerated routes ([#discussioncomment-19804237](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19804237)).
